name: Primary calorimetry evidence and source-separated validation preflight
numeric_input: reported microkelvin signed offset, gravity-corrected and averaged C_s J/(mol K)
physical_label: table caption ABOVE/BELOW, NOT independent phase diagnosis
symbolic_scale: 5 Hz/(J/mol K), authored, not a physical sound frequency
uncertainty: missing per row, null, no zero imputation
split_protocol: future study-level source-frozen holdout, no row leakage, independent physical diagnostic labels, per-row positive errors, lineage audit
retrospective_status: protocol written after inspection of the 1984 table; not preregistered relative to this dataset
holdout_accuracy: never compute from published table-side context or synthetic test fixtures
invalid_source_independence: MAT-SPEC-005 compilation and 1984 report may share experimental lineage
output_rule: canonical ASCII JSON and CSV only; no WAV, PCM, other sampled audio or MIDI playback
missingness: never fabricate measured phase absence, per-row uncertainties or absolute Kelvin temperatures
source_rights: source numerical facts excerpted with attribution; original publication rights retained
